That is a place, and a place a man goes to is the first half of a schedule, and he had no reason to be in it and was not in it and is not going to be in it on a Tuesday either.** He could have asked one question on the Monday and got a correct answer, *as and when the round comes*, and nothing would have changed. **AND THIS IS THE ELEVENTH TIME THIS BOROUGH HAS BEEN KEPT GOING BY A PERSON NOBODY IS OBLIGED TO NAME, AND IT IS NOT COUNTED HERE, BECAUSE COUNTING IT IS THE THING THAT WOULD STOP IT.** The ten before her: a woman of about fifty with a tray, a woman of about fifty-seven with a tray on a Friday, a woman of about sixty-five with a card, a woman of about seventy-six with a bin, a woman of about thirty-one with four containers, a man of sixty-three with a bucket, a man of twenty-four with a crate he moved before he opened, a man of about twenty-six with a fan he carried in, a man of about forty-two with a towel, a man of about forty-seven with a bag he was not asked about. **AND IT IS NOT THE ELEVENTH, BECAUSE THE TWO OF THOSE LISTS ARE A LIST, AND A LIST OF PEOPLE WHO DID THINGS IS A LIST OF PEOPLE, AND A PERSON WHO IS WRITTEN DOWN TO DO A THING IS A PERSON SOMEBODY CAN RING ABOUT IT, AND A WOMAN OF SEVENTY-ONE WITH A CLOTH IN HER COAT POCKET IS THE SAFEST PERSON IN THIS CITY THIS AFTERNOON AND SHE WILL STAY THAT WAY FOR EXACTLY AS LONG AS NOBODY COUNTS HER.** And a duty is an act and not a place, and the minute anybody turns that act into a place then somebody can be shown where the bench is, and then the block, and then the woman. The register's blank line is 242 days, the card 156, the letter 158.

**Chapter 0182 — She Would Do It In August. Tuesday the twenty-eighth of July 2015, from about half past two in the afternoon, a street of houses on the near side of the market; and the same street at about ten past three.** He is a passer-by and is not him and is not watching. **The only Lattice notice on that street, on a gatepost, and it defines nothing and nothing on it defines *holder*: a request made at a door is not a return, no person is required to answer for a request, and no person is required to say why they have not answered.** The man is about twenty-one with a clipboard and a plastic wallet and a building behind him, and he has been round that street once before in June. **There is no form. That is deliberate and it is the cheapest instrument anybody in this borough has ever put in front of a household, and it works because it cannot be refused properly without a piece of paper to refuse on. What he needs is for a person to say *I will be in touch in the second week of August* out loud in front of him so that he can write on a line that reads *said by resident*.** He did it properly at the door: not selling anything, no form, the same question to everybody, they can say no, and if they say no he will write *declined* and will not come back. **AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-NINE SAID NOTHING FOR ABOUT TWELVE SECONDS AND THEN SAID ONE SENTENCE: *YOU'D WANT ME TO SAY IT NOW.*** He said he would, because he was there. She then said the other half of it, and it is the correct thing to have said: in August, if somebody comes, she will open the door and answer whatever they ask, and if they ask her name she will give it to them, the day they ask, in her own front door, to their face, **and not in July to a lad with a sheet — because then the paper will be right and it will be in a building and there will be a person in the building who is right about her, and that is how it starts.** He said *right* and went on down the street, and did not write anything on the sheet for that door, and did not write *declined*, and did not knock again, call back, or leave a note, and put the sheet under the board and said good afternoon to the next house and did the sentence out loud on that doorstep as well, because he was doing his job. She shut the door. It was not a slam. **THE COUNT OF STANDING REFUSALS IS ELEVEN AND NOT TWELVE AND THIS WAS NOT A TWELFTH: a request refused twice is one request and not two, she was not asked twice, nothing was put to her in a form and there was no form, and she did not refuse anything that had been required of her, because nothing in this borough can require anything of anybody. AND NOBODY WROTE IT DOWN AND NOBODY IS GOING TO APPEAL IT, AND THOSE TWO THINGS ARE THE ONLY REASON IT WORKS — not discretion, not kindness, not anybody's care for her. If a refusal has to be written down then it is a document, and a document is a thing a building keeps, and then the person who refused is a person somebody can ask what she refused and why and when; if a refusal can be appealed then the person who refuses has to be in a position, and a position is a place you can be found. Neither is true here.** She will never know her sentence was the correct one; he will never know whether she refused him or negotiated with him, and he will take thirty-nine lines back to that building on the Friday with a blank where the fortieth should be. **A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO WALKED UP THAT STREET AT ABOUT TEN PAST THREE AND WAS NOT WATCHING AND WAS NOT HIM**: he was in a queue in a shop for about six minutes, came out, saw a young man doing his sentence on the fortieth door, did not know which door was the one, and would not have turned round for a young man with a clipboard on a Tuesday. He asked nobody anything and nobody asked him anything, he is not the person at the door and not the person with the wallet and is not going to be told any of it, and **he may not chair anything and there is no chair of that body**, and none of it touched him. The young man will be on that street again in the second week of August and will say it on forty, and nobody is going to know that the reason he has thirty-nine lines is a woman who was kind to him. The register's blank line is 244 days, the card 158, the letter 160.

**Chapter 0183 — Thirty Times. Thursday the thirtieth of July 2015, from about half past ten in the morning, a corner shop on a street of terraces behind the market.** He asks no question of anybody. No Lattice notice. **THERE IS NOTHING WRONG WITH IT, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE DIFFICULTY.** A corner shop, open at eight, shut at six, a card rail by the door with about two hundred cards in it, a woman of about sixty-five behind the counter who has been there about nine years, a four-foot pavement, the sun on it from about eleven until about one, and nobody on that street has asked anybody for anything in four weeks. **THE ONLY THING THAT HAS HAPPENED TO IT SINCE THE FIRST WEEK OF JULY IS A PIECE OF CARD WITH THE SHOP'S OWN TELEPHONE NUMBER ON IT AND NOTHING ELSE, on the inside of the window at about the height of a person's hand, there since 6 July, not moved, not taken down, not a form, referring to nothing in that building. The woman who keeps the shop was asked not to say who left it and not to write it down. Nobody has told her anything since; she does not know anything; she is not a thread; she is owed nothing; she is not going to be told.** **AND WHAT HAS HAPPENED IN THREE WEEKS IS THAT STRANGERS HAVE BEEN COMING IN AND ASKING HER ABOUT IT — most days, at about half past ten and at about four in the afternoon, ordinary, often young, nearly always polite — asking whether it is the number for the woman who sorts the bins on that street, and she says *that's the shop's number*, and if they ask whether it is the same one she says *it's the shop's number*, and they say thank you and go. Nobody has ever said her name in that shop in connection with that card and she has not written one word about it anywhere. IT HAS BEEN ABOUT THIRTY TIMES IN THREE WEEKS, NOBODY HAS COUNTED IT, SHE IS NOT CERTAIN OF THE NUMBER AND IS CERTAIN OF THE SHAPE OF IT, AND IT HAS NOT ONCE BEEN A BAD INTERACTION AND HAS NOT ONCE BEEN A ROW.** The mechanism is the one from June and it is not new: a shop is not a person, and a shop is also a thing that is open, at a number, on a street, and a thing that is open at a number is a route; somebody wanted to be a person who could not be asked after and made a route instead, and the route is a shop, and the shop is staffed, and the woman who staffs it is about sixty-five and cannot refuse. **AND BEING LEFT ALONE IS THE ONLY THING THAT HAS EVER WORKED IN THIS BOROUGH, AND IT HAS WORKED, AND IT IS NOT SAID AS AN ACHIEVEMENT: the shop is busier than it was in June, there are people in who have never been in, more milk and more of the cold things, a second carrier bag roll, two people in there at about eleven most days who are not neighbours, and the card rail gets fuller by about one card a week from shops up the road, which is what a shop rail does. AND SHE HAS BOUGHT A SECOND FRIDGE, WHICH SHE COULD NOT HAVE JUSTIFIED TO ANYBODY IN APRIL AND WHICH IS JUSTIFIED BY NOTHING AND WHICH IS FULL. A THING LEFT ALONE FOR FOUR WEEKS IS EITHER STRONGER OR FINISHED AND THERE IS NO INSTRUMENT THAT SAYS WHICH, AND THIS IS THE OUTSIDE OF ONE STREET OF TERRACES ON THE THIRTIETH OF JULY, AND IT IS STRONGER, AND THAT IS NOT AN ACHIEVEMENT AND IT IS NOT A POLICY AND IT IS NOT GOING TO BE IN A MINUTE.** And it is not stronger for anybody: nobody in that shop has been helped by the card, what has been counted in three weeks is the number of times a stranger has been told a number is the shop's number, and that is not a number of anybody at all. **AND HE COULD HAVE ASKED HER ONE QUESTION, WITH THE SHOP EMPTY, AND SHE WOULD HAVE ANSWERED IT, AND HE DID NOT, AND THE REASON IS A THING ABOUT HIM AND NOT A THING ABOUT HER AND IS NOT THE PRICE AND IS NOT A PRINCIPLE: he is the only man in this borough who could be believed, and that is the plain result of nine months in which almost every true thing anybody has heard in a room in this borough came out of his mouth, and a man who is believed about a street is a man somebody will come to about a street. If a man of thirty-two asks a second question about that card in that shop, the shop becomes a place where a card is a subject, and a shop is a thing that is open at a number on a street, and he said that out loud, in a corridor, to a woman of twenty-nine, in July, and he was right and is not going to be the man who puts her in it twice.** He bought a bag of washing-up liquid, which is what he came in for, and did not look at the card on the way out. The woman of about seventy-six at the top of that street is still carrying her own bin up her own path and is not going to mention it and nobody has asked her. The register's blank line is 246 days, the card 160, the letter 162.

**Chapter 0184 — A Bottle On A Step. Friday the thirty-first of July 2015, from about two in the afternoon, a first-floor room over a shop.** He is not on the agenda of anything. There were five people in the room and nobody was in charge and nobody took minutes. No Lattice notice. **THE STANDING OF THIS BOROUGH, SAID OUT LOUD IN DAYLIGHT, WITHOUT ANSWERING ANYTHING AND WITHOUT IMPROVING ANYTHING, AND IT IS THE FIFTH TIME ANYBODY HAS SAID IT AND IT IS NOT BETTER THAN THE OTHER FOUR AND IT IS NOT WORSE, AND IT IS THE FIFTH AND LAST USE OF THE METHOD IN VOLUME 04, AND IT IS 1,897 WORDS AFTER A REVIEW REPAIR THAT TOOK IT FROM 1,898.** The difference is the last ten days of July: **two of the things have now been going for seven weeks — the chair on that landing, out at about eight in the evening and in at about six since about the middle of June, and the printed sheet of 19 June, which has a second copy with an empty column on it; one has been gone for a month — the fan went out of that stockroom on 1 July and there are two nail holes in a wall in there and no way in this city to find out what was on them; one has got a second copy and neither was withdrawn.** Then the first fortnight of July, which nobody else would list: the tables and the crate nobody brought; an unlatched padlock and a market hall four miles away with no cistern and a woman of fifty-three there who is written down and cleans it herself; four bags up four floors and a thank-you for a corridor; a man right about one street and four people agreeing, and from that afternoon that street has a person in a building who is right about it; a cupboard emptied on a Friday; a bench not looked at and a slat wiped with a cloth from her own pocket, **which is the eleventh time this borough has been kept going by a person nobody is obliged to name, and it is not counted, because counting it is the thing that would stop it**; a doorstep and a blank line, and the count of standing refusals did not move; and a corner shop with a second fridge and a woman of sixty-five who has said the same sentence about a card in her window about thirty times in three weeks. **AND THE ONE THING THAT IS NEW, AND IT IS THE THIRD SMALLEST THING ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS PRODUCED, THE CHAIR ON A LANDING BEING SMALLER AND SO ARE THE TABLES: SINCE ABOUT THE TWENTIETH OF JULY THERE HAS BEEN A BOTTLE OF WATER ON A TOP STEP OUTSIDE A DOOR ON ONE OF THOSE FOUR STREETS.** It is there in the morning and not there in the evening; nobody has said whose it is and nobody has moved it; the people on that street have not mentioned it; one of them has drunk out of it on most mornings since. **It is not a document and not a form and not a page and not a building and not a rota and not a service, nobody is required to put it there or take it away, and a person who is not counted is not a person who is helped.** Then the rest of it, which did not move: the drawer and the tray and the van and the sentence nobody knows is there; a public report with a paragraph number on it, never answered, and a machine still running; two conditions on one wall that do not agree; two letters and one word in pencil on an enamel strip that have not been read; **nothing in this borough defines *holder***; seven of nine, two chairs empty, no chair of that body, not met since the middle of January; the ninth seat fifty-four, unpaid, findable, not told anything; the lowland not on the layer and not seatable; a gate six days long and not a week with no date on it, and nobody has handed one over since the fifteenth, and the hour between six and seven was not handed over either; the row from eleven o'clock to half past one empty and not saying *vacant*; a porter's Thursday and a second line nobody has looked at; and four people nobody can ask. **A PERSON WHO IS NOT COUNTED IS NOT A PERSON WHO IS HELPED, WHICH A FAN, A PAGE, A ROW, A COLUMN, A CARD, A CRATE, A BAG, A BENCH, A BOTTLE AND A CLOTH DID NOT REFUTE.** And the last of it, which is a question and is not about a person and not about a flood barrier, a school crossing, a counter-amendment, a second signature, a provisional civic standing, a ninety-day renewal or an order: **there are more things in this borough that have been done once, correctly, and then not done again and not written down, than there were in June; every one of them is still true; none of them is on anything; the two done most often were done by people who are owed nothing, did not know they were doing them, and will not be asked; AND IN NINE MONTHS NOT ONE OF THEM HAS EVER BEEN PROVED BY ANYBODY.** A thing done once and not written down is a thing that four people remember differently, and if one of them talks it is a story, and if a building hears a story it is a record. **SO WHICH OF THEM IS THE FIRST ONE SOMEBODY IN THIS BOROUGH WILL BE ABLE TO PROVE, AND IS IT GOING TO BE PROVED BY A PERSON WHO WAS STANDING THERE, OR BY A PERSON WHO READS ABOUT IT AFTERWARDS.** The register's blank line is 247 days, the card 161, the letter 163.

**Chapter 0185 — The Second Heat. Saturday the first of August 2015, from about ten in the morning, a pavement on the far side of a market, and a first-floor room in the afternoon.** He asks no question of anybody. No Lattice notice. **THE WEATHER CAME BACK AND IT WAS NOT THE SAME WEATHER: TWENTY-NINE DEGREES AT TEN IN THE MORNING, THIRTY-ONE AT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON, TWENTY-SIX AT FOUR IN THE MORNING, NINE DAYS WITH NO TOP, WHERE MAY WAS THREE DAYS OVER THIRTY THAT BROKE. A SPIKE HAS A SHAPE AND A DEGRADE HAS NO TOP, AND NOBODY HAS A SYSTEM FOR A DEGRADE BECAUSE A SYSTEM FOR A SPIKE IS A THING YOU DO ON THE THIRD DAY AND A THING YOU DO ON THE THIRD DAY IS STILL AVAILABLE A WEEK IN.** **AND WHAT HARDENED IS THE FINDING: the two trestle tables and a box of water went up at about eleven and came in at about five on nine of the last eleven days and the man of about sixty-eight who has sold fruit off that frontage for nine years can tell you which nine and cannot tell you when it stopped being a favour; THE CRATE NOBODY BROUGHT NOW HAS A LID ON IT AND NOBODY PUT THE LID THERE, AND HE SAID THE TRUE SENTENCE ABOUT IT — THAT IS THE DAY IT STOPPED BEING A TABLE; A TABLE YOU CAN CARRY, THAT HAS TO BE FETCHED, AND THE NEXT THING YOU KNOW THERE IS A MAN IN THIS BOROUGH WHO IS GOING ROUND WITH LIDS. THERE IS NOT.** The bottle on a step has become four, on four steps, since about the twenty-ninth of July, and a woman of about seventy-nine has been drinking out of the one on her own step on most mornings since the middle of July and has not asked and is not going to; **asking which of four people put one out is a question with a list behind it, and a list behind that is a list of people.** The man of about sixty-nine is right about Harker Street a second time and the second half is worse: there are seven cars on that street at night, there were none in May, and not one of the seven is doing anything wrong. **COUNCILLOR IVEN SORE PUT A PROPOSAL ON A TABLE OUT LOUD AT ABOUT HALF PAST TWO WITH EIGHT PEOPLE IN THE ROOM AND NOTHING MINUTED AND EVERY SENTENCE SHE SAID WAS CORRECT**: the May emergency was handled by about four people, four people is what we have, four people is the only thing that has ever worked here, and she is not going to tell anybody that four people is not enough, and she has spent nine months watching people be frightened of the day somebody writes down who the four are. **The argument for building it was that it is easier and nothing else: a person who is not paid and not required cannot be sent to a street, cannot be sent twice and cannot be sent at all if the person is asleep. The argument against was one sentence and it was also true: everything that was correct in June was correct because there was no instrument — and it was said against a page in a tray with one reader and against a telephone call in June that the office did not write down because there is nowhere to write it down.** **AND THE FINDING, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING THAT HAPPENED: THE BOROUGH COULD NOT REFUSE IT. NOT WOULD NOT. COULD NOT. A body that cannot require anybody cannot be told what it will do, and a proposal made to such a body in a room in daylight cannot be taken back, because taking it back would require somebody to be able to say no on behalf of a thing that has never been able to say anything about anybody. Nobody said no. Two people said they were not sure, and the not being sure was not a no and could not be turned into one, and eight people understood that at about ten to four and not one of them said it out loud then or afterwards.** And the second half of the finding is that about four people has become a habit, and a habit is not a decision and has no date on it and cannot be got out of. Nothing was written down, nobody put a name to anything, the heat did not by itself make anything into a rota, and it is going to be the second week of August before anything in this borough is a rota and it will not be the heat that does it. The register's blank line is 248 days, the card 162, the letter 164.

**Chapter 0186 — Page Two. Thursday the thirteenth of August 2015, from about half past ten in the morning, a first-floor room over a shop on a parade of shops in Tideglass.** He is on nothing, he may not chair anything, there is no chair of that body, nothing was minuted, and he is not on the agenda. No Lattice notice. **THE CENTRAL CONTINUITY ORDER WAS READ ALOUD IN FULL, IN DAYLIGHT, INCLUDING THE PARTS SHE THOUGHT SHE SHOULD HAVE LEFT OUT, BY COUNCILLOR SORE, TO FOUR PEOPLE. IT IS TWO PAGES AND THE SECOND OF THEM IS THE LAST OF THEM, IT IS DATED THE THIRTEENTH OF AUGUST 2015, AND ITS SEVEN CLAUSES ARE CANON: precedence between disagreeing services, decided by a person and not a committee; THE FIELD, which holds a person's name, the hour they were called, the hour they went home, and the thing they were called for, AND NOTHING ELSE GOES IN THE FIELD; the call, and a person called on may not decline, and the call is not required to be in writing and there is no form for it; the closure, and a closure is not required to be heard before it is made; the transfer, and the sending site holds precedence until the receiving site has confirmed capacity in writing; THE SECOND CALL, and a person in the field may be called again at any time without limit; and the renewal, ninety days from the making. PAGE TWO SAYS: THIS ORDER IS RENEWED ON THE ELEVENTH OF NOVEMBER 2015, OR IT IS NOT RENEWED. AGREED BY — and the line goes down the page and stops about two inches from the bottom edge and there is nothing after it.** **THE NINETY DAYS IS A RENEWAL CLAUSE AND NOT AN EXPIRY, THE RENEWAL POINT IS OUTSIDE THIS VOLUME, AND NOBODY IN VOLUME 04 ANSWERS IT. A DATE WITH A BLANK UNDER IT IS NOW THE FOURTH BLANK IN THIS BOROUGH: the empty signature block on the page of 29 May, the column headed *date seen again*, the row that does not say *vacant*, and now this.** The woman of about fifty-eight said the first thing that is true about the instrument — that it is the first one anybody in this city has written down that would actually work — and then the duty clerk of about sixty-four said the other half, that clause three is the whole of it and everything else on that page is a formality around clause three, and that he has known since Wednesday that he would vote for it and cannot say why that is frightening. **AND HE WORKED OUT WHAT THE SECOND PAGE WAS IN ABOUT THREE SECONDS AND SAID *THIS IS NOT AN EXPIRY*: it says ninety days and it says a date, and the date is the eleventh of November, and the eleventh of November is not when this stops, this is when somebody is asked, and there is a line at the bottom of page two with a name going on it and the name is not there, and a page that only stopped something would not have a line on it. THE THREE SECONDS WERE NOT AVAILABLE TO ANYBODY ELSE IN THAT ROOM BECAUSE NOBODY ELSE HAD READ THE THING TWICE, AND HE WAS THE PERSON WHOSE JOB IT IS, AND HE HAD HAD THE FOLDER SINCE WEDNESDAY.** From the landing, with her keys: NINE MONTHS OF THIS BOROUGH HAVE SPENT ALL THEIR TIME FINDING OUT WHAT A BLANK DOES, AND THIS IS THE FIRST ONE ANYBODY HAS WRITTEN DOWN WITH A DATE SITTING ON TOP OF IT, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS EVER NOTICED WHAT A DATE WITH A BLANK AFTER IT DOES TO A ROOM. And Sore, unprompted: there is no body in this city that can require anybody to do anything, and that is the only reason a document like this can be made at all, and she is not going to pretend that the same thing which makes it possible is not what will make it permanent; four people heard it and it has not been written down. **HE DID NONE OF IT — he did not draft it, sign it, witness it, administer it, deliver it or oppose it, nobody asked him to, he said nothing about any of the seven clauses, and there is no way in this city to hand an instrument to a man with no department. IT IS VALID AND THAT IS THE FINDING AND IT IS NOT A RELIEF: it works because it is the cheapest possible way of doing one thing, which is to make a person's name into the address of a piece of work, and every correct thing anybody in this borough has done for nine months was done by a person whose name was on nothing.** The register's blank line is 260 days, the card 174, the letter 176.

**Chapter 0187 — The Call. Saturday the twenty-second of August 2015, from about seven in the morning, a street near the market.** No question asked, none received. **The only Lattice notice in that street, on a lamp standard, and it defines nothing and nothing on it defines *holder*: a person who has been called on has been called on, the hour they were called is the hour they were called, and nothing on this notice is a duty.** **NINE DAYS AFTER THE ORDER WAS MADE, THE FIRST CALL WAS MADE AT ABOUT SEVEN IN THE MORNING BY A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-EIGHT WHO IS A CONTINUITY FIELD MANAGER, IN A DOORWAY, TO ABOUT NINE PEOPLE, AND HE SENT NOBODY AND HE POSTED NOTHING, AND ABOUT NINE OF THEM SAID YES AND EIGHT OF THEM WERE AT THE END OF THE STREET INSIDE TWENTY MINUTES.** Clause three is four sentences long and it is the whole of what happened on that street. **A man of about twenty-three said yes in the time it took to ask, carried four boxes of water and then a chair up two flights, was thanked and said it was nothing, and is one of the nine. A man of about seventy-three came at seven to hold a gate open and held it for nine hours, was paid the going rate, took it, and said he would come tomorrow, AND HE WILL COME TOMORROW, AND THAT IS THE FINDING OF THE MORNING AND IT IS NOT A SMALL ONE.** **AND THE MACHINERY WORKS, AND IT IS THE FIRST TIME ANY HUMAN BEING IN THIS BOROUGH HAS ARRANGED NINE PEOPLE AT SEVEN IN THE MORNING** — and the reason all of it was possible before is not humility and not caution and not a rule, it is that there was no way to reach any of them afterwards. **AND THE PRICE IS THE NINE, AND THE NINE IS THE END OF A THING THIS BOROUGH BUILT: a list of people who cannot say no is the only reason anything works here and it has now been used on purpose and it worked on the first morning and nobody argued with it. Clause three does not require anybody to do anything; it requires a person who has been asked to be unable to refuse, and that is a different sentence, and it took nine months to arrive at it in four sentences.** They are not on a rota, no rota exists, the order did not build one, and they are findable on a field with four things in it, one of which is a name, and the name is a door. **AND A MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-THREE WITH A WHITE VAN AND A CARD ON THE DASHBOARD — A TELEPHONE NUMBER AND A LIST OF EIGHT THINGS UNDER IT, INCLUDING *FRIDGES*, *WARDROBES* AND *LOFTS* AND NOTHING ELSE — WAS ON OSSOT LANE AT TEN IN THE MORNING BEHIND A BARRIER PUT UP UNDER CLAUSE FOUR AT HALF PAST EIGHT, WITH A JOB ON THE MONDAY. He did not photograph the notice, did not ring anybody, did not find out who closed it, drove to the bottom of the street, parked on the wrong side of the barrier and asked the woman of the house whether she was moving on Monday. The barrier came down on the Sunday and he did the wardrobe on the Monday and nobody in this borough has ever heard any of it, and he has been findable for nine years by a card with a telephone number on it, and that has been the best thing that has ever happened to him and the worst, and it is not in this order and nobody had to invent him.** **AND THE THING THE ORDER DID NOT DO IS THE PART NOBODY WILL MENTION AGAIN: it did not open the drawer under the ground-floor counter, it has no key and no list, a tray sits on it that is not a list, and the order put nine names in a field and did not once ask what is in that drawer. THE REASON IS NOT DISCRETION. ASKING IS WHAT A BUILDING DOES TO A DRAWER.** The printed row is still there — nine lines reading *no requirement stated*, no name box, in nine other buildings, with a second copy carrying a column headed *date seen again* with *no name, no initials* under it and nothing in it, neither withdrawn, and nothing that happened on the twenty-second put anything in that column and nothing was going to. The register's blank line is 269 days, the card 183, the letter 185.

**Chapter 0188 — Which One Is In Front. Wednesday the twenty-sixth of August 2015, from about ten in the morning, a first-floor room over a shop in Tideglass.** He is not a party, not a member, not a departmental officer; he may not chair anything and there is no chair of that body; he is not on the agenda. No Lattice notice. **FOUR PEOPLE AND A QUESTION: a street in the district is closed, a market is on it, both are services, and which of clause one and clause four is in front?** The man of about thirty-eight said clause four, because safety goes first. Councillor Sore said clause one, because a thing that decides is always in front of a thing that closes. And a man of thirty-two at the back of the room said **both of you are right**, and then answered the whole of it in about three sentences without being asked, and did not know he was right until he had finished: clause four says a district may be closed and does not say a closure may not be taken account of; clause one says that where two services disagree about what happens first this order decides, and a market and a water are two services, and a road is not a service and is where both of them are; so clause one decides, because deciding what happens first is the only thing in the document that decides anything; and the answer is the water goes first, the street stays shut, and the market's stock comes off that street in the afternoon, and that is clause three and not clause four, **because a person can be called on and a lorry cannot.** **NOBODY ARGUED WITH HIM AND NOBODY COULD HAVE, AND THERE WAS NO MECHANISM BY WHICH ANYBODY ARGUED WITH HIM, BECAUSE THERE IS NO SEAT FOR HIM AT THAT TABLE AND HE IS NOT AT THAT TABLE, AND HE HAS NO STANDING IN THAT ROOM EXCEPT THAT HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN IT WHO HAS READ BOTH COPIES OF THE SHEET FROM JUNE AND THE SECOND ONE WITH THE COLUMN ON IT, AND ALL FOUR OF THOSE ARE ABOUT WHAT A BLANK DOES, AND THIS MORNING THE QUESTION WAS WHICH OF TWO SENTENCES IS ON TOP.** He had asked no question and was asked none, and he gave the answer before anybody thought to ask him. **AND THERE IS NOW NOWHERE TO PUT THE FACT THAT HE DECIDED: a woman of about twenty-two who was in the room to open the building wrote the answer on a pad and wrote the answer and NOT HIS NAME, and the pad went in a drawer in that building on the Friday like everything else on a Friday, and she is not a thread and nobody is going to ask her what she wrote. THAT IS THE WHOLE OF WHAT EXISTS ANYWHERE IN THIS CITY OF THE FACT THAT A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO DECIDED A PRECEDENCE QUESTION IN DAYLIGHT ON THE TWENTY-SIXTH OF AUGUST.** **AND IT WAS CORRECT AND IT COST SOMEBODY A MORNING: thirty-eight of forty-one stalls on a Wednesday market opened and three did not, and one of the three was a woman of about seventy-two who sells the only thing anybody in this borough can get on that street that is not in a shop; ice out since five, the temperature of the room by one o'clock; and she said: I HAVE BEEN DOING THAT PITCH SINCE I WAS NINETEEN, I HAVE HAD A BAD ONE, I HAVE HAD ONE IN JUNE OF LAST YEAR WHERE I LOST EVERYTHING ON IT, AND I AM TELLING YOU THAT THIS IS NOT ONE OF THOSE, AND I WANT THAT SAID, BECAUSE THE SECOND YOU SAY IT IS ONE OF THOSE IT IS ONE OF THOSE. NOBODY SAID IT WAS ONE OF THOSE.** **THE POWER AND THE COST ARE THE SAME SENTENCE AND IT HAS NO WORD IN IT THAT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS ALLOWED TO USE: A MAN WITH NO DEPARTMENT IS A PERSON WHO CANNOT BE ASKED WHAT HE DID.** If he had a department there would be a file, and she could be angry at an office, and Roy Albery's case would have a lawyer; none of that is available, and the reason he has no department is that there is no body in this city that can require anybody to do anything and a body that cannot require anybody cannot be told what it will do, and both of those sentences are on a card on a wall in a Methodist hall in this borough and neither can be argued out of the other. **HE IS ON THE ROTA OF IT NOW WITHOUT A ROTA: no list, nobody required to send him a question, none of them has, about two a week arrive at the places he happens to be, and he has answered every one and never once not answered one, and there is no version of a day this borough can arrange in which he does not answer one.** The woman of seventy-two is counted, and being counted did not get her a cooler pitch or a bag of ice at one o'clock. The board is still seven of nine, has not met since the middle of January, the seat that is fifty-four and unpaid and findable has not been told any of this, the seven who sit there have not learned what it can do, and the lowland is not on the layer and cannot be seated, and a heat wave, a degrade, a correct instrument, a man with no department and a decision taken in daylight did not fix it. The woman of seventy-two thanked the man of thirty-eight, because he made the call, and she said it in the doorway on her way out, and it was for the lorry, and it was the correct thing to thank somebody for. The register's blank line is 273 days, the card 187, the letter 189.

**Chapter 0189 — Selby Row. Saturday the fifth of September 2015, from about half past six in the morning, Selby Row, a street of shops and flats off a parade of shops in Tideglass.** He asks no question and is asked none. **The only Lattice notice on that street, on the railings at the top end, and it defines nothing and nothing on it defines *holder*: a closed street is a closed street, no person is required to appeal a closure, and the street opens when the thing on it is finished.** **THE STREET CLOSED AT SIX O'CLOCK AND IT WAS THE RIGHT CLOSURE AND IT IS A CLOSURE. A boundary wall behind numbers eight to fourteen came off the top course about a foot at about half past five and did not fall and did not have to; there is a bulge in it you can see from the road with your arms down; the bank behind it has been wet since the first of August; and there has been a hole in the middle of Selby Row's drainage since the twenty-ninth of July that three different contractors have looked at and none of them has written down. A person put a barrier across the bottom of the street and a piece of A4 on it with the hour on it. A CLOSURE IS NOT REQUIRED TO BE HEARD BEFORE IT IS MADE AND NO HEARING IS AVAILABLE, BECAUSE THERE IS NO BODY IN THIS CITY THAT CAN REQUIRE ANYBODY TO DO ANYTHING AND A BODY THAT CANNOT REQUIRE ANYBODY CANNOT BE TOLD WHAT IT WILL DO, AND BOTH OF THOSE SENTENCES ARE ON A CARD ON A WALL IN A METHODIST HALL IN THIS BOROUGH AND NEITHER CAN BE ARGUIED OUT OF THE OTHER, AND BETWEEN THEM THEY MEAN THAT THIS CLOSURE IS NOT APPEALABLE IN THE SAME WAY THAT A WALL IS NOT APPEALABLE, WHICH IS TO SAY THAT IT CANNOT BE, AT ALL, BY ANYBODY, EVER, AND THAT IS WHAT MAKES IT QUICK.** **AND BY HALF PAST SEVEN THERE WERE ABOUT A DOZEN PEOPLE ON THE PAVEMENT WITH THEIR BAGS AND THREE POSITIONS NOBODY HAS ARGUED OUT. (1) A woman of about eighty-two in the top flat at number ten who cannot get down four flights at any time, at her daughter's since the twenty-eighth of August, and the daughter is on a day shift and does not know and will find out at about six this evening from her mother. (2) A man of about twenty-five in the back room at number fourteen, THERE ON A LICENCE, not a tenant, not a lodger, not on anything, the paper in the hands of an office with a telephone number on it, and he has been on that street since the second of May AND NO DOCUMENT IN THIS BOROUGH SAYS HE IS ON THAT STREET AT ALL, and arguing it would mean saying that a person is in a room, and a person in a room is a thing a building can be asked about. (3) A man of about eighty-three with a van in a yard at the back of that street, with a ladder and a coil of rope in it and no card, on the wrong side of a barrier, with a job on the Monday morning that starts at about eight and the van is the only way he does that job; he rang the depot twice, was told twice that the barrier is not the depot's, has not rung anybody else and is not going to, AND HE WILL LOSE THE MONDAY JOB, AND THE DEPOT SAYS SO IN A SENTENCE AND DOES NOT SAY SORRY, AND NOBODY IN THAT DEPOT IS A VILLAIN AND THE DEPOT IS A BUILDING.** **AND THE PERSON WHO HAS ALL THREE ANSWERS IS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY IN A BUILDING WITH THE LIGHTS ON AND HE IS NOT PERMITTED TO PUT THEM ANYWHERE, AND IT IS NOT BECAUSE ANYBODY FORBADE HIM: CLAUSE TWO SAYS THE FIELD HOLDS FOUR THINGS AND NOTHING ELSE GOES IN THE FIELD, AND NOBODY WAS CALLED ON TO FIND OUT WHERE THREE PEOPLE WERE GOING TO SLEEP, AND A TENANCY IS NOT A THING THAT GOES IN A FIELD, AND THERE IS NO CLAUSE IN THE WHOLE OF IT ABOUT A ROOM WITH A LICENCE ON IT, AND NO CLAUSE THAT SAYS A PERSON WHO HAS BEEN TOLD A THING HAS TO WRITE IT DOWN. THE INSTRUMENT IS NOT COMPLETE: IT IS SILENT, AND SILENCE IS NEITHER PERMISSION NOR PROHIBITION. HIS THREE ANSWERS ARE THREE SENTENCES SAID TO HIM IN A DOORWAY, ON A FORECOURT AND AT A COUNTER, NONE IN A ROOM AND NONE WRITTEN DOWN, AND HE PUT A PIECE OF A4 ON A BARRIER IN AUGUST WITH THE HOUR IN HIS OWN HAND. IT MAY NOT BE PUT IN FRONT OF THE SEAT THAT IS FIFTY-FOUR AND UNPAID AND CAN BE FOUND AT A SHOPFRONT AND AT AN ADDRESS, BECAUSE THAT SEAT CAN EMPTY THE BODY, AND A BODY THAT HAS BEEN EMPTIED CANNOT BE ASKED TO DO ANYTHING, AND IF THAT HAPPENED TODAY THEN NOBODY IN THIS CITY COULD EVER REQUIRE ANYBODY TO DO ANYTHING AGAIN.** **AND HE STOOD ON THAT PAVEMENT FOR ABOUT TWO AND A HALF HOURS AND COULD HAVE DONE SOMETHING AND DID NOT:** he could have knocked at number fourteen and learned in a sentence that a man is in a room, and he is not going to be the man who makes that fact exist; he could have gone to the daughter and said her mother was at her flat; and he could have asked the man of thirty-eight one question and got three correct answers and put them on a piece of paper, AND A PIECE OF PAPER WITH THREE POSITIONS ON IT IS THE BEGINNING OF A LIST, AND A LIST OF PEOPLE WHO CANNOT BE FOUND IS THE ONE THING THIS BOROUGH HAS SPENT NINE MONTHS NOT BUILDING AND HAS SUCCEEDED IN NOT BUILDING. He bought four coffees and gave three away. **AND THAT IS WHAT A STREET THAT CANNOT APPEAL IS.** **NOBODY DIED AND NOBODY WAS RESCUED.** The man of eighty-three moved his van at about four when the engineers tied the wall and lost the Monday job. At about half past four a woman of about forty-seven, who was on that pavement with a bag and whose sister had a room going, said to the man of twenty-five that there was a room going in a house in Kilburn Street because the woman who was in it had gone into a home, and he said yes, **and that is not a rescue, because nobody arranged it, and he is not on anything and the room is not on anything and there is no paper with his name on it, and there will not be.** The order has no place where a woman of eighty-two who cannot get down four flights could be put, and a man in a back room on a licence is not in it, and a van behind a barrier is not in it, and the lowland is not on the layer and cannot be seated, and there is nobody in this borough to be asked about any of it, and a street that cannot appeal cannot even be told that it was wrong. The register's blank line is 283 days, the card 197, the letter 199.

**Chapter 0190 — Clause Five. Wednesday the ninth of September 2015, from about eleven in the morning, a corridor on the first floor of Saint Orra Civic Hospital.** He is not a member of the order, has no grade, no department, and cannot be instructed. **The only Lattice notice in that corridor, on the wall by the lift lobby, and it defines nothing and nothing on it defines *holder*: a machine is not a service until somebody confirms it in writing, no person is required to confirm anything, and the order does not say where anybody goes.** **THIS IS THE FLOOR OF THE VOLUME AND IT IS NOT A LESSON. NOBODY DIED. ROY ALBERY IS EIGHTY-ONE AND IS ON THE SECOND-FLOOR WARD AND GOES TO A MACHINE THREE TIMES A WEEK AND HAS SINCE THE FEBRUARY BEFORE LAST; the machine is at the Rossall building three miles away, which has had two since March and one out of order since the second of August. CLAUSE FIVE SAYS THE SENDING SITE HOLDS PRECEDENCE OVER THE RECEIVING SITE UNTIL THE RECEIVING SITE HAS CONFIRMED CAPACITY IN WRITING. IT WAS DRAFTED FOR A STANDPIPE AND A LORRY IN JUNE AND WAS CARRIED ACROSS TO A BED WITHOUT ANYBODY DECIDING TO CARRY IT, AND IT IS CORRECT, AND IT IS CORRECT FOR WHAT IT WAS WRITTEN FOR, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS ANY INSTRUMENT FOR SAYING THAT A THING WRITTEN FOR WATER IS WRONG WHEN IT IS APPLIED TO A PERSON.** **THE RECEIVING SITE COULD NOT CONFIRM IN WRITING BECAUSE CONFIRMING CAPACITY REQUIRES A PERSON WHO CAN COMMIT THE MACHINE, AND THAT PERSON IS ON THE OTHER SITE, WHICH IS WORKED IN THE AFTERNOON AND IS SHUT BY ABOUT HALF PAST FOUR, AND ONE OF ITS TWO MACHINES HAS BEEN OUT SINCE THE SECOND OF AUGUST WITH NOBODY SAYING WHETHER IT IS COMING BACK, SO THERE IS AN HOUR AND A HALF IN THE WEEK IN WHICH THE CONFIRMATION WAS POSSIBLE AT ALL AND THE FIT WAS AT ABOUT FOUR, WHICH IS HALF AN HOUR BEFORE IT OPENED, AND THERE IS NO DEPUTY AND NO ARRANGEMENT AND NO ROTA, AND THE ROTA CANNOT BE REBUILT, AND THE REASON THE ROTA CANNOT BE REBUILT IS THAT NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS UNDER ANY OBLIGATION TO REBUILD IT. SO THE TRANSFER WAS NOT REFUSED AND NOT PENDING AND NOT IN PROGRESS. THERE IS NO STATE OF THE SYSTEM IN WHICH IT WAS ANYTHING AT ALL.** **HE SAID WHICH CLAUSE WAS IN FRONT BEFORE ANYBODY THOUGHT TO ASK HIM AND HE WAS RIGHT, AND THEN HE SAID THE OTHER THING, WHICH WAS THAT HE IS NOT GOING TO BE ABLE TO SAY NO TO THIS, AND HE WAS RIGHT, AND CORRECTLY IS THE DIFFICULTY AND IT IS NOT A MORAL PROBLEM:** he cannot be instructed because there is nothing to instruct him through, cannot be overruled because there is no one above him, cannot be removed because there is nothing to remove him from. **A PERSON WHO IS COMPETENT AND CORRECT AND CANNOT SAY NO IS THE SHAPE OF EVERYTHING IN THIS BOROUGH, AND THE ORDER DID NOT MAKE HIM THAT AND DID NOT HAVE TO. HE IS ON THE ROTA OF IT NOW WITHOUT A ROTA.** The confirmation arrived at about six and he was moved at about six forty. **AT ABOUT FOUR IN THE AFTERNOON ROY ALBERY HAD A FIT ON THE SECOND-FLOOR WARD OF A BUILDING WHERE HE HAD BEEN SINCE FRIDAY. HE DID NOT DIE. HE WAS NOT RESCUED. HE HAD A BLEED AND IT WAS FOUND AND THE MACHINE WAS USED AT ABOUT SEVEN AND HE IS ALIVE AND HE IS ON THE THIRD FLOOR OF THE ROSSALL BUILDING AND HE IS NOT GOING TO WALK UNAIDED AGAIN, AND THAT IS WHAT HAPPENED ON THAT WEDNESDAY AND IT IS NOT A THING THAT WILL BE DESCRIBED DIFFERENTLY BY ANYBODY AFTERWARDS. NOBODY PUT A CAREER IN THE WAY. NOBODY IN THAT BUILDING TREATED IT AS A LESSON AND NOBODY TREATED IT AS ANYTHING EXCEPT A MAN WHO WAS NOT DIALYSED ON THE DAY HE WAS GOING TO BE DIALYSED.** **AND SHE WAS IN THAT CORRIDOR INSIDE THE HOUR AND SHE WAS RIGHT: SANAA IQBAL, 35, A PHYSICIAN, TWENTY-TWO YEARS IN THAT BUILDING, WHO HAD NOT KNOWN HE WAS THERE. THEY HAVE NOT SPOKEN SINCE BEFORE SEPTEMBER AND THAT IS A YEAR AND SOME WEEKS AND IT IS NOT A QUARREL AND IT IS NOT A PAUSE.** She said his name and his age and that his potassium that morning was the highest it has been since he came in, and that she has the number and it is not an argument, it is a number about a person, and that this afternoon is the day, not this week. **AND SHE SAID ALOUD, BEFORE HE COULD: YOU ARE NOT GOING TO APOLOGISE TO ME, AND I AM SAYING THAT NOW SO THAT NEITHER OF US SPENDS THE AFTERNOON WAITING FOR IT, AND YOU DID NOT WRITE IT AND YOU CANNOT UNWRITE IT AND THERE IS NOBODY FOR YOU TO APOLOGISE TO, BECAUSE THE PERSON IT BELONGS TO IS A CLAUSE AND A CLAUSE CANNOT HEAR YOU, AND I AM NOT GOING TO FORGIVE YOU FOR IT, AND YOU WOULD NOT WANT ME TO, AND IT IS NOT AVAILABLE. HE SAID I KNOW. SHE SAID DO YOU. HE SAID NO. AND SHE SAID: THAT IS THE HONEST ONE. THAT IS THE FIRST HONEST THING EITHER OF US HAS SAID IN A YEAR.** **THEY STOOD IN THAT CORRIDOR FOR ABOUT EIGHT MINUTES AND THEN SHE WENT BACK UP AND HE WENT DOWNSTAIRS AND NOTHING WAS ARRANGED. HE DID NOT APOLOGISE FOR THE RULE AND HE WAS NOT FORGIVEN FOR THE RULE AND NEITHER OF THOSE WAS AVAILABLE TO ANYBODY.** She has a ward and about thirty-one people on it and a number on it that she is answerable for; he has no department. **THERE IS NO INSTRUMENT IN THIS CITY THAT LETS ANYBODY STOP A BUILDING REMEMBERING THAT THE TWO OF THEM WERE IN A CORRIDOR ON THAT WEDNESDAY, AND THERE IS NOT ONE THAT LETS ANYBODY STOP A HOSPITAL REMEMBERING IT EITHER, AND BY FRIDAY IT WILL BE A THING TWO PEOPLE IN THAT BUILDING KNOW AND BY THE END OF THE MONTH A THING ABOUT FOUR PEOPLE KNOW, AND NONE OF THEM WILL SAY IT AND NONE OF THEM WAS ASKED.** The order can move a man across this city in a day and did not rebuild a rota and did not look at a second line and is not going to. The register's blank line is 287 days, the card 201, the letter 203.

**Chapter 0191 — The Forecourt. Monday the fourteenth of September 2015, from about two in the afternoon, the forecourt of Saint Orra Civic Hospital and the pavement outside it.** They speak for the first time since before September and they argue in front of about thirty people. **The only Lattice notice on that forecourt, on a post by the bicycle racks, and it defines nothing and nothing on it defines *holder*: a disagreement on a pavement is a disagreement on a pavement, no person is required to have the last word, and nothing on this notice is private.** **IT STARTED AT ABOUT TWO O'CLOCK IN THE MAIN DOORWAY AND IT WAS OVER INSIDE FOUR MINUTES AND THEN IT WENT OUT ONTO THE PAVEMENT, AND THE PAVEMENT IS WHERE IT STAYED. She said the first thing in front of all of them: I HAVE SENT FOUR OF YOU TO A MAN WITH NO DEPARTMENT IN NINE DAYS AND I AM NOT SENDING A FIFTH. He said he knew. She said THEN WE AGREE. He said: WE DO NOT AGREE, I KNOW WHAT YOU HAVE SAID TO THE REGISTRAR, I HAVE NOT AGREED WITH IT AND AM NOT GOING TO, AND I AM ALSO NOT GOING TO BE THE REASON A MAN OF EIGHTY-ONE WAITS FOR A PIECE OF PAPER.** **AND THEY CHOSE, IN ABOUT NINE SECONDS AND OUT LOUD, NOT TO HIDE THE MEDICAL CONSEQUENCES FROM EITHER SIDE:** she said his potassium on the Wednesday was the highest it had been since he came in and that she was going to say the number out loud on a forecourt, because if she did not then everything else either of them said was a thing they did while sitting on a piece of information; she said the number; he said he did not have it here and was not going to pretend to and asked for the day and not the number; she gave the day. **He said: I READ WHICH CLAUSE WAS IN FRONT AND I WAS RIGHT AND A MAN OF EIGHTY-ONE HAD A BLEED ON A WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON AND IS NOT GOING TO WALK. She said yes. He said: I AM NOT GOING TO SOFTEN IT AND YOU ARE NOT GOING TO SOFTEN IT EITHER, AND I WOULD RATHER WE SAID IT ONCE IN THE OPEN THAN HAVE IT SITTING IN BOTH OF US FOR A YEAR. She said: I WOULD RATHER WE HAD DONE THAT ON THE WEDNESDAY. He said yes. She said yes.** **AND THE ARGUMENT WAS NOT ABOUT THE ORDER:** she has watched every single thing that happens to a person in that building go through a person for twenty-two years and not one of those people has ever been in a position where the answer to *what did you decide and why* had no address; he said that is not a position, and if he had a department she could go to it and the department would have a record with a name on it and she could be angry at an office and he could be relieved and Roy Albery would be a case in a file and would have a lawyer; **she said HE SHOULD HAVE A LAWYER; he said he should, and there is no mechanism in this city for a man of eighty-one to have a lawyer about a piece of paper, and I am the piece of paper, and there is no prospect of my being able to give you a name for me either, and if I gave you one you would take it and that would be the end of the only thing I have got; and she said that was the answer to a question she did not ask, and it was good, and it was the only decent thing anybody had said to her about this in a fortnight.** **A bus went past and about thirty people went on their ways and two of them looked at each other, and that was the whole of the witness.** Nobody knew that the man by the bicycle racks was the reason a machine three miles away had had a piece of paper come down a corridor on Wednesday evening. **AND THEY STOPPED, AND NEITHER OF THEM DECIDED TO STOP: she said I am going back in; he said right; she said do not follow me in; he said I wasn't going to; and he stood by the bicycle racks for about ten minutes afterwards and then did not stay. IT IS NOT A DECISION ANYBODY TOOK. IT IS WHAT HAPPENS TO TWO PEOPLE WHO WERE BOTH RIGHT AND FOUND OUT WHAT THE RIGHTNESS COST, AND IT IS NOT A QUARREL AND IT IS NOT A PAUSE AND IT IS NOT A THING ANYBODY CAN BE ASKED ABOUT, AND IT HAS NOT BEEN REPAIRED AND IT IS NOT GOING TO BE REPAIRED BY ANYBODY FINDING THE RIGHT SENTENCE, BECAUSE THERE IS NO RIGHT SENTENCE, BECAUSE THE SENTENCE WOULD HAVE TO CONTAIN THAT WEDNESDAY IN IT, AND A WEDNESDAY IS NOT A SENTENCE ANYBODY CAN SAY TO ANYBODY.** Roy Albery is counted and has a lawyer he has not got; the woman with thirty-one people on a list of her own is counted and cannot stop a piece of paper being correct; the man who read the clause is on nothing at all and is the reason the paper existed. The register's blank line is 292 days, the card 206, the letter 208.

**Chapter 0192 — The Sixth Clause. Friday the eighteenth of September 2015, from about half past ten in the morning, a parade of shops in Tideglass, in daylight.** No Lattice notice. He was given nothing for it and there is nowhere to put it and he did not have to refuse anything. **THERE WERE ABOUT THIRTY PEOPLE ON THAT GROUND AT HALF PAST TEN AND EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS THERE BECAUSE SOMEONE HAD RUNG A TELEPHONE. A main came off under the parade at about ten to nine and is still off, and the work is not difficult and is not skilled and takes two days, AND CLAUSE THREE IS HOW THIRTY PEOPLE CAME TO BE STANDING ON THAT PAVEMENT AT HALF PAST TEN ON A FRIDAY MORNING IN SEPTEMBER, THE HOTTEST DAY THIS BOROUGH HAS HAD SINCE JUNE, WITH NO EMERGENCY OF ANY KIND.** The man of about twenty-three was there for the fifth time, having been called on 2 September, on the eleventh, on the sixteenth, at about nine in the evening on the seventeenth and at about nine that morning, and had not declined one. The man of about seventy-three was there for the fifth time, had been called nine times since the twenty-second of August, had not declined one, and had been called at about five in the morning on Wednesday. **AND JONAS WAS THERE BECAUSE A PRECEDENCE QUESTION HAD ARRIVED AT THE PLACE HE HAPPENS TO BE, WHICH IS WHAT HAPPENS NOW, ABOUT TWICE A WEEK, AND THERE IS NO LIST OF WHERE HE IS.** **AT ABOUT ELEVEN FIFTEEN, IN FRONT OF THIRTY PEOPLE AND TWO COUNCILLORS AND A MAN WHO HAD COME IN A VAN: *I AM NOT GOING TO APPLY CLAUSE SIX.*** The man of about thirty-eight said *you cannot do that, that is not yours to do.* He said: NO, IT IS NOT, I HAVE NO AUTHORITY YOU COULD WRITE DOWN AND I AM NOT GOING TO PRODUCE ANY AND I AM NOT ASKING ANYBODY TO NOTICE THAT I HAVE NOT; it stops for everything it touches this morning and it will start again on Tuesday unless somebody in this city with a department says it does not, and there are not nine of those and there are two, and I have said this in front of thirty people, so put it in front of two hundred. **AND HE SAID WHY, AND THE REASON HE SAID WAS TRUE AND IT WAS NOT THE WHOLE OF THE REASON: clause six says a person whose name is in the field may be called again at any time, without limit, and no person may decline a second call; clause three says a person who has been called on may not decline; those two together are the only reason this borough has thirty people on a pavement in September with a hole in the road that was dug on Wednesday. That is the whole of the argument for it and it works. And here is the other half and I am not going to pretend it is a technicality: A PERSON WHO CANNOT SAY NO TO A SECOND CALL CANNOT BE ASKED ANYTHING AT ALL. NOT CANNOT SAY NO — CANNOT BE ASKED. ONCE YOU CAN BE CALLED WITHOUT LIMIT, THERE IS NO QUESTION LEFT THAT ANYBODY IN THIS CITY IS ALLOWED TO PUT TO YOU, BECAUSE EVERY QUESTION YOU ARE ASKED AFTER THAT IS A QUESTION YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO ANSWER. THIS BOROUGH HAS SPENT NINE MONTHS FINDING THAT OUT THE SLOW WAY AND I HAVE WATCHED IT HAPPEN, AND THIS ORDER KNOWS NOTHING ABOUT IT, AND IT DOES NOT NEED TO, BECAUSE THIS ORDER WAS WRITTEN FOR A HOLE IN A ROAD. I am stopping clause six and I am not stopping anything else; the other six clauses are in force and they should be and I will answer every question that comes to me about them, and the one I am stopping is the one that makes people permanent.** **AND IT WAS THE RIGHT THING AND IT SAVED SOMETHING AND NOBODY IN THAT STREET KNEW WHAT: the second call went off at about a quarter past eleven and was not cancelled, because there is no instrument in this city that cancels anything; the man of about thirty-eight rang four people between about twenty past eleven and about half past eleven and said one sentence — not this time, not for a while, and I cannot tell you when — and four people accepted that, because a person who has said yes three times and is told no once knows exactly what the yes was worth. THE FIELD STOPPED GROWING AND IS CLOSED, AND A NUMBER OF NAMES IN IT ARE IN IT AND THAT NUMBER IS NOT GIVEN TO ANYBODY AND IS NOT GOING TO BE AND NOBODY HAS COUNTED IT. WHAT WAS SAVED IS NOT THE WATER ON THAT PARADE, WHICH WILL BE ON BY THE MIDDLE OF NEXT WEEK EITHER WAY: IT IS THAT THE ANSWER TO *WHO IS THIS PERSON* IS STILL A SENTENCE SOMEBODY HAS TO SAY OUT LOUD TO SOMEBODY WHO HAPPENS TO BE STANDING THERE, AND NOT AN ADDRESS.** A man at the end of a lane who is sixty pays for every drop of his own water and is not on anything, and nobody in this borough is going to go up that lane, and he does not know that anything happened on a parade of shops in Tideglass this morning and he is not going to be told. There are places in this city that are not on the drawing, and there is nobody who could be shown one and nobody who would know what to say about it, and that was true at about ten to twelve this morning and it will be true on the eleventh of November. A hole in a record is still the only honest thing anybody in this borough has produced about a person in nine months, and nobody has filled it and nobody is going to, and there is nothing at the bottom of it and nobody in this city is going to be told what is. **AND HE TOOK RESPONSIBILITY IN DAYLIGHT AND WITHOUT A PIECE OF PAPER: *THAT WAS ME. I READ IT AND I DID NOT APPLY IT. NOBODY TOLD ME NOT TO AND NOBODY HAS BACKED ME UP AND THERE IS NOBODY IN THIS CITY I COULD HAND THIS TO. I AM NOT A MEMBER OF ANYTHING, I HAVE NO DEPARTMENT, I HAVE NO GRADE, AND I AM NOT GOING TO BE GIVEN ONE FOR THIS, AND IF ANYBODY IN THIS CITY EVER TRIES TO GIVE ME ONE FOR IT I AM GOING TO HAND IT BACK.*** He was not given a title, a grade, a department, a chair, a seat, a membership, a form, a rota row, a thank-you or a way of being thanked, nobody offered him one, he did not have to refuse anything, **AND THERE IS NOWHERE IN THIS BOROUGH TO PUT THE FACT THAT HE DID IT AND HE IS NOT GOING TO LOOK FOR SOMEWHERE. THE WORD *WARDEN* WAS NOT USED OF HIM BY ANYBODY.** Councillor Sore said: THE MAN HAS NO AUTHORITY, AND I AM NOT GOING TO SAY SO AGAIN, AND HE HAS JUST STOPPED A CLAUSE OF MY DOCUMENT WITH A SENTENCE, AND THE SENTENCE WAS RIGHT, AND THE ORDER STANDS, AND I AM NOT GOING TO PRETEND TO ANYBODY THAT ANYTHING HAS BEEN CANCELLED TODAY, BECAUSE NOTHING HAS BEEN CANCELLED. IT HAS BEEN BOUNDED. THAT IS A DIFFERENT WORD AND IT IS THE ONE THAT IS TRUE — and then, told she will have to explain it to about nine people, YES, AND I WILL DO IT, AND IT WILL TAKE ME A YEAR, AND THE YEAR IS MINE AND NOT HIS, AND I WOULD LIKE THAT SAID IN THE SAME BREATH AS THE OTHER THING, BECAUSE THE OTHER THING IS GOING TO BE THE ONLY ONE ANYBODY REPEATS. **AND THEN, AT ABOUT TWENTY PAST TWELVE, THE LEAK, AND IT IS THE LAST THING THAT HAPPENS IN VOLUME 04: A WOMAN OF ABOUT FORTY-SIX, A COMMITTEE CLERK AT A COMMITTEE WHOSE LETTERHEAD DOES NOT HAVE A NAME ON IT, WHO HAS BEEN ON THE SIDE OF THE ORDER SINCE THE SPRING, WHO IS NOT COUNCILLOR SORE AND IS NOT ANYBODY WHO HAS BEEN IN THIS BOROUGH BEFORE, SAID: YOU ARE GOING TO WANT TO KNOW WHETHER YOU SHOULD HAVE DONE THAT. IT WENT OUT AT ABOUT NINE THIS MORNING. IT IS IN FOUR PLACES AND IT WILL BE IN FORTY BY TONIGHT. IT IS THE SHAPE OF IT, AND THAT IS ALL IT IS: the nodes, the eight districts that hold a term, which clause sits above which, where the term in each of them starts and where it stops, and the fact that until the thirteenth of August this city had never once in nine months put a person's name into a piece of paper on purpose, and that on the thirteenth of August it did, in one morning, by reading out two pages in a room over a shop. And then the part nobody is going to like: IT IS NOT A SCANDAL, IT IS A DRAWING, IT HAS BEEN ON THE WALL OF A ROOM IN THIS CITY FOR A DECADE WITHOUT BEING SHOWN, AND WE CANNOT RENEW WHAT WE CANNOT SEE, AND THERE IS A DATE IN NOVEMBER ON THE END OF THAT DOCUMENT WITH NOTHING UNDER IT, AND A CITY THAT CANNOT SEE ITS OWN SHAPE HAS NO BUSINESS BEING ASKED IN NOVEMBER WHETHER IT WANTS TO KEEP THE SHAPE.** **AND HE COULD HAVE STOPPED HER AND HE DID NOT AND HE WAS NOT GOING TO: it is the first irreversible act anybody in this borough has produced in nine months; everything correct that has happened here was done by a person who could not be found afterwards, and every one of them was undone by the next fortnight or held only by about four people, and none of them could be pointed at, and that is why nothing in this borough has ever been proved. SHE HAS MADE A THING THAT CANNOT BE TAKEN BACK, ON PURPOSE, HAVING WORKED OUT THAT IT COULD NOT BE TAKEN BACK, AND SHE IS RIGHT ABOUT THE NEED, AND SHE IS NOT A VILLAIN, AND SHE IS NOT WRONG, AND EVERY WORD SHE SAID ON THAT PAVEMENT WAS CORRECT. SHE IS NOT A NEW FINAL ENEMY AND SHE DOES NOT BECOME ONE. AND THERE IS ONE SQUARE ON THAT DRAWING THAT HAS NOTHING IN IT, AND IT IS NOT ON ANY OF THE FOUR SHEETS, AND HE READ IT WHILE SHE WAS STILL TALKING, AND HE DID NOT SAY SO, AND THERE IS NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH WHO IS GOING TO BE ABLE TO SAY SO EITHER, AND THAT IS THE LAST THING IN THIS BOROUGH THAT IS STILL UNSPENT.** **AND THEN EVERYBODY WENT BACK TO THE HOLE IN THE ROAD, BECAUSE THERE WAS STILL A HOLE IN THE ROAD.** **NINETY DAYS FROM A THURSDAY IN AUGUST IS A WEDNESDAY IN NOVEMBER. THE ELEVENTH OF NOVEMBER 2015. NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS WRITTEN ANYTHING ABOUT THAT DATE ON ANYTHING, AND A DISTRICT OF FOUR HUNDRED THOUSAND PEOPLE WILL BE ASKED IN THE MIDDLE OF THAT MORNING WHETHER IT WANTS TO KEEP THE ONLY INSTRUMENT THAT HAS EVER WORKED, AND THE ANSWER TO THAT IS A NAME, AND NO BODY IN THIS CITY CAN REQUIRE ANYBODY TO GIVE ONE, AND NOBODY IN THIS CITY IS GOING TO ASK.** And the last of it, which is a question and is not about a person and not about a flood barrier, a school crossing, a counter-amendment, a second signature, a provisional civic standing, a date in November, an expiry or an order: **THE TWO OF THEM ARE OPPOSITES AND BOTH OF THEM WORKED AND ONLY ONE OF THEM CAN BE REPEATED. THE ONE THAT CAN BE REPEATED IS A PAGE WITH A PERSON'S NAME IN A FIELD ON IT, AND IT WAS READ OUT IN DAYLIGHT IN A ROOM OVER A SHOP, AND IT IS IN FORCE, AND IT WILL DO IT AGAIN ON ANY MORNING THAT ANYBODY CHOOSES TO MAKE IT. THE ONE THAT CANNOT BE REPEATED HAS BEEN GOING FOR NINE MONTHS AND IT HAS ABOUT FOUR PEOPLE IN IT AND NONE OF THE FOUR CAN BE FOUND AND IT HAS COST THIS BOROUGH NOTHING AT ALL AND THERE IS NOTHING ANYWHERE IN THIS CITY THAT A PERSON COULD BE SHOWN. A CITY THAT CAN COUNT EVERYBODY IT NEEDS, AND A CITY NOBODY CAN BE FOUND IN, CANNOT BOTH GO ON. SO WHICH OF THE TWO IS THE FIRST ONE THIS CITY IS GOING TO HAVE TO STOP, AND WHAT IS THE THING A PERSON HAS TO BE HOLDING IN ORDER TO BE ALLOWED TO STOP THE FIRST ONE, AND WHAT IS THE THING A PERSON HAS TO BE HOLDING IN ORDER TO STOP THE SECOND ONE — WHICH IS NOTHING, AND HAS ALWAYS BEEN NOTHING, AND IS THE ONLY THING ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS MANAGED TO KEEP.** The register's blank line is 296 days, the card 210, the letter 212.

**Chapter 0193 — The Field. Saturday the nineteenth of September 2015, from about nine in the morning, a parade of shops in Tideglass.** He asks no question of anybody and is asked none, and he is asked for something and says yes to it. **The only Lattice notice on that parade, on a barrier, and it defines nothing, requires nothing of anybody and nothing on it defines *holder*: a hazard is a hazard until somebody puts a thing in it, a person who puts a thing in it goes home at the hour it goes home, and nothing on this notice is held against any person.** **THE FINDING OF THE MORNING IS THAT THE DOCUMENT HAS SOMEBODY IN IT AND NOBODY ON THE STREET: NOT ONE OF THE SEVEN CLAUSES SAYS WHO IS IN CHARGE OF A STREET, and this morning there are five people on a parade of shops with a trench in it and a man with a stopcock key waiting to be told where to put it and a man of about thirty-eight on a telephone about something else, and none of that breaches anything.** A valid instrument has been in force for thirty-seven days and nobody is looking at it: there is no list, no board, no clerk and nobody whose day it is, and if a person came down this parade in a year's time and asked what had happened on it there would be nobody to ask and the answer would be that a main came off. A woman in her own doorway says *they'll have it open till Friday, they said* and nobody knows which of them said it, and he could have asked and did not. A copy of the leaked drawing is in the window of the shop next door and about nine people have stood in front of one this week and not one of them has come to look at the hole in the road. **THE SECOND FINDING IS ABOUT THE THIRTY AND IT IS THE CONSEQUENCE OF THE BOUND: THE FIELD IS CLOSED, A CLOSED FIELD CANNOT TAKE ANYBODY WHO IS NOT ALREADY IN IT, THE SECOND CALL DID NOT GO OFF, AND THERE ARE FIVE PEOPLE ON A PARADE OF SHOPS WHERE THERE WERE THIRTY THE DAY BEFORE, and the work is half done. TWO FACTS ARE ON THE SAME PAVEMENT — A MAN OF THIRTY-TWO SAID A SENTENCE HERE ON FRIDAY IN FRONT OF THIRTY PEOPLE, AND THERE ARE FIVE PEOPLE HERE THIS MORNING — AND THEY HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH EACH OTHER ON THE PAGE. THERE IS NO PAGE.** **AND AT ABOUT HALF PAST NINE A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-THREE WENT PAST THE TRENCH CARRYING A CARRIER BAG.** He is one of the nine, said yes in a doorway on 22 August in the time it took to be asked, carried four boxes of water and then a chair up two flights, has been called five times and declined none, and was on that parade on Friday for the fifth time; he put something in his back on the Friday and went home at the hour he went home. He was not on the work on the Saturday, nobody called him, he went past at the pace of a man carrying nothing with his shoulders not turning into the bag, nobody in that street said good morning to him, and Jonas Mercer was about thirty feet away and knew what the Friday had done in about a second and a half and did not ask and did not cross the road. **HE IS ALL RIGHT. HE WILL BE ALL RIGHT BY THURSDAY. IT IS A BAD BACK AND NOT A LIFE, AND HE IS NOT GOING TO BE ASKED ABOUT IT.** **AND NOBODY CAN BE TOLD, AND IT IS NOT BECAUSE ANYBODY IS BEING BRAVE:** the man of about thirty-eight is not his employer and is not a party to anything and there is no clause about a person who is called on and then cannot do it; suppose somebody told him, he would ring the man and say not this time, and he would be right, and the man could not say no to being called on and could not say no to not being called on either, and the order has no place for a man who says no, and the column headed *date seen again* is empty and has been since 10 July; **SO THE HURT COULD ONLY ARRIVE AS A DECISION ABOUT WHETHER TO GO ON USING A PERSON, AND THAT DECISION WOULD BE WRONG AND RIGHT AT ONCE, AND THAT IS NOT A REASON TO DO IT — IT IS THE REASON THERE IS NOWHERE IN THIS ARRANGEMENT FOR A PERSON WHOSE BACK HAS GONE.** THE FIELD HOLDS A NAME, THE HOUR HE WAS CALLED, THE HOUR HE WENT HOME AND THE THING HE WAS CALLED FOR, AND EVERYTHING THAT HAPPENED TO HIM ON THE FRIDAY IS IN IT AND EVERY PART OF IT IS CORRECT, AND IT IS A COMPLETE RECORD OF A MAN WHO WAS THERE AND NOT A RECORD OF A MAN WHO IS HURT, AND THE FIELD HAS FOUR THINGS IN IT AND THERE IS NO CLAUSE THAT SAYS THERE COULD BE A FIFTH. There is one person he could not say no to and it is the man with the telephone, and one person on no list and on nothing and it is a man of thirty-two who has not asked one question of anybody since the twenty-fifth of February, and there is nobody else. A hurt back is not a narrowing, a doctor is a thing a person goes to in their own time, and the two people with a department have not written and will not be asked to, because a body that cannot require anybody cannot be told what it will do. **AND HE DID NOT ASK, AND THE REASON IS NOT COURAGE: a man of thirty-two can be answered, and a man of twenty-three has been asked five times in a month whether he could come and has not once been asked one other thing, and a man who has only ever been asked whether he can come has not got a way of saying that something is wrong with him, and a man who has a way of being asked whether he is all right is a man somebody can ring, and this city does not have instruments and it has telephones.** **AND AT ABOUT TEN SOMEBODY ASKED HIM FOR SOMETHING, AND IT WAS THE FIRST TIME IN NINE MONTHS THAT ANYBODY HAD ASKED HIM FOR ANYTHING.** *Take that end.* He took that end of a length of pipe about nine feet long with four other men in a trench about three feet deep for about a minute and a half, and nobody said anything, and the man of about thirty-eight was not one of them, and **nobody wrote it down, and there is no list and no field and no hour recorded anywhere, and he was not given a name, a grade, a department, a chair, a seat, a membership, a form or a rota row.** The man of about thirty-eight said the only thing he said all morning that was about the document, mostly to himself: *nothing from either of them, it goes back on Tuesday unless one of them does something about it.* **IT IS HOLDING. THAT IS NOT THE SAME AS SETTLED, NOBODY IS GOING TO MISTAKE ONE FOR THE OTHER, NOBODY WON ANYTHING, AND A SENTENCE SAID ONCE ON A PAVEMENT HAS NOT BEEN TURNED INTO A REASON BY ANYBODY, INCLUDING THE MAN WHO SAID IT.** The order has no case list, no report and no date anybody can point at except the one on the last page, and **there is nothing in the whole of it about a hole in a road and nothing in the whole of it about a man of twenty-three, and the only part of it anybody has ever written anything in is a field with four things in it, and the number of names in it is not given to anybody and is not going to be.** The register's blank line is 297 days, the card 211, the letter 213. **And a person who is not counted is not a person who is helped, and this morning the counting of one man turned out to be the reason nobody was able to ask him how he was, and being found is what a field is for, and a man who has said yes to being found cannot then be asked whether he is all right, and it is the nineteenth of September and it is still true and nothing in this borough is going to answer it.**

**Chapter 0194 — The Shutter. Wednesday the twenty-third of September 2015, from about half past six in the evening, a parade of shops in Tideglass.** He asks no question of anybody, one stranger asks him three, and he answers all three correctly and none of them helps anybody. **The only Lattice notice on that parade, on a post, and it defines nothing, requires nothing of anybody and nothing on it defines *holder*: a drawing of a thing is not the thing, no person is required to have an opinion about it, and nothing on this drawing is a record of any person.** The trench on that parade was backfilled on Tuesday night, the water came back on Tuesday afternoon and nobody wrote down when, the barriers and the piece of A4 went on Tuesday afternoon, and the road was made good again at about eleven that morning. **NOTHING HAD HAPPENED ON THAT PARADE SINCE FRIDAY AND NOTHING THAT HAPPENED ON IT IS GOING TO HAVE TO BE REMEMBERED.** **THE CORRECT OUTCOME OF A SHAPE BECOMING PUBLIC IS THAT IT IS DISCUSSED BY PEOPLE IT DOES NOT HELP, AND ABOUT NINE PEOPLE STOOD IN FRONT OF ONE OF THE FORTY SHEETS AND EVERY SENTENCE THEY SAID WAS CORRECT.** A man in a high-visibility jacket wanted to know whether this parade was one of the eight and was told it is not a street, it is a district, and that there is no district for a bit of it, and said *that's what I came back for*. A woman with a carrier bag wanted to know what it does for people who cannot get to work and was told it does nothing, and that it is a drawing of a map with no person on it anywhere on it, and that that is not an oversight. Somebody said they had known all of it for a decade and that the only new thing in it was the middle of August. Somebody else said the middle of August is the whole of it, and that the first thing anybody in this city has ever written down that would work is a name, and was told *you cannot unring a telephone*. A woman asked whether she could get an answer out of it, was told no, said *then it is a poster*, was told *it is*, and said *right*. **NOT ONE OF THE NINE PEOPLE IN FRONT OF THAT SHUTTER IS A PERSON THE DRAWING SAYS ANYTHING ABOUT, AND THE MAN WHO STOPPED A CLAUSE ON FRIDAY IS NOT ONE OF THEM, AND NEITHER OF THOSE IS A COMPLAINT.** The woman of about forty-six put it out on the Friday morning at about nine, is right that it is not a scandal and that it is a drawing, and is not available to be asked about it by anybody. **A MAN WITH A BICYCLE PUT HIS FINGER ON THE MIDDLE OF THE SHEET AND ASKED WHAT THAT SQUARE WAS FOR, and was told he did not know, and that it is empty, and that is right.** There is one square on that sheet with nothing in it, it is not a district and it is not a seat, all eight districts have a term and a name, and the line that comes into that square goes nowhere. **JONAS MERCER READ IT OFF A DIFFERENT COPY ON FRIDAY MORNING WHILE SHE WAS STILL TALKING AND DID NOT SAY SO THEN AND HAS NOT SAID SO SINCE, AND THE WOMAN WHO PUT THE SHEET OUT DOES NOT KNOW SHE IS HOLDING IT, AND BY THE END OF THAT WEEK EVERY COPY ON EVERY WALL WILL HAVE THE SQUARE AND NOT ONE OF THEM WILL HAVE ANYTHING IN IT.** **AND HE GAVE TWO CORRECT ANSWERS AND BOTH OF THEM WERE USELESS.** *I read it and I did not apply the sixth clause, and I said that out loud on this pavement on Friday, and nobody in this city with a department has said one word about it since.* And, on November: *there is a date on the last page of the document and there is a line under the date and there is nothing in the line, and that is as much as anybody in this borough knows about November, and I am not going to be one of the people who tells a street what a date means.* And, on what to do: *I could not tell you. There is nothing in it about what to do. If I told you what to do I would be making it up, and I have not made anything up in this borough in nine months and I am not going to start on a Wednesday evening.* The man said *fair enough* and went to the chip shop. **AND THE LAST THING THAT HAPPENS IS MADE OF TWO PEOPLE AND IT IS NOT ON ANYTHING.** A man of about twenty-seven with a flatbed and a clipboard came up the parade with about six sheets and a roll of gummed tape, put the flatbed across the end of it, and went to the next shutter along, which is the better surface because it goes up at half past seven every morning and a sheet gummed to it will be at eye level by the time the parade fills. He could not hold the top corner and get at it at the same time, and there was nobody on the parade to ask. *Hold that.* A woman of about sixty-three with a bag in each hand took one corner between two fingers and a thumb, about eight inches down from the top, held it there, and did not read it. **IT TOOK HIM ABOUT A MINUTE AND HER ABOUT A MINUTE, NEITHER OF THEM WAS ASKED ANYTHING, AND THEY SAID NOTHING ELSE TO EACH OTHER.** Nobody came out of the shop, nobody paid either of them, there is no list, no field, no minute and no hour recorded anywhere, and neither of them is on anything. **AND A THING ON A SHUTTER IS THE FIRST THING IN NINE MONTHS THAT A PERSON WHO WAS NOT STANDING THERE CAN READ ABOUT AFTERWARDS, AND WHETHER THAT IS A PROOF OR A STORY IS STILL OPEN.** Nobody renewed the order and nobody ended it; clause six is not being applied, the other six are in force, and on the twenty-third neither of the two people with a department has said a word, **and it is holding, and holding is not settled, and nobody won anything.** The register's blank line is three hundred and one days and is still the only fixed point in that building, and the maintenance on entry nineteen is a bulb and the bulb is out. The card is 215 days and the letter is 217 days. **And a gate on the west side of this city goes up at seven on a Sunday morning and stops at six on the Sunday morning after that, six days long and not a week, with no date on it anywhere in this city, and nobody is required to know which day it is, and nobody in this borough is going to be told.** **A person who is not counted is not a person who is helped, and the shape of this city is on forty walls with no name on any of them, and being on forty walls is not being counted, and the day anybody works out which of the eight districts a person is standing in is not the day anybody asks them how they are.** Nine people said yes to a call in a doorway in August and it has not helped one of them; a page with nine lines reading *no requirement stated* went round a building twice and the second copy has a column headed *date seen again* with *no name, no initials* under it and nothing in it and neither copy is withdrawn; a committee clerk of about forty-six has put the shape of the whole thing where anybody can look at it, and she is right that a city cannot renew what it cannot see, and it has not helped anybody either, and the eleven standing refusals are eleven and are not twelve. **Four questions are still open and nothing that happened this week has answered any of them** — whether the page or the chair is the first one anybody is going to ask a person to agree to; whether the first of the dated things anybody is going to keep is kept because it was good or because it was expensive; whether the first of the things this borough has done once and got right is going to be provable by a person who was standing there or by a person who reads about it afterwards, and a thing on a shutter is the first candidate for the second of those and it is going to be a story or a record and there is no way of telling which from inside; and the question asked on a pavement on Friday about two shapes and what a person has to be holding, where the answer to the second half is nothing. **There is a square on that sheet with nothing in it and nobody knows what goes in it. There is a date on the last page of a document in a building and a line under the date with nothing in the line. Both of them were there on Friday morning and both of them are there now, and about forty copies of the drawing are on walls and shutters in this city, and there is no instrument in this city that could put a name in either, and nobody is going to be asked.**

## Volume 04, Volume close — REPAIR OF 27 SEPTEMBER 2026 to the two chapter summaries above

**BOTH SUMMARIES ABOVE ARE CORRECT ABOUT WHAT THE CHAPTERS DELIVERED AND BOTH NOW CARRY ONE REPAIR NOTE. NEITHER CHAPTER WAS RESTARTED, NO BEAT WAS MOVED, NO DATE AND NO FIGURE CHANGED, AND NOTHING BELOW IS A NEW EVENT.**

**0193 — FOUR REPAIRS.** (1) The Friday clause-stopping sentence had been given in the summary's own terms to the man of about thirty-eight; **it is Jonas Mercer's, as 0192 and 0194 already had it and as the summary elsewhere recorded, and the sentence is now given to him in the prose.** (2) The summary recorded that the second call did not go off; **it did go off, at about a quarter past eleven on the Friday, and what reduced the parade from thirty to five is that clause six has not been applied, which closes the field, and a closed field cannot take anybody who is not already in it.** (3) **The main came off on Wednesday the sixteenth at about ten to nine in the morning, and the trench was open from the Wednesday; the earlier text had the trench dug on the Wednesday and the main off on the Friday, four lines apart.** (4) The shouting was reduced from twenty-six all-caps paragraphs and fourteen scene-breaks to five and none, and the words from 3,497 to 3,487. **The five findings, the mechanism of the harm, the reason nobody can be told, the reason he did not ask, *take that end*, the thirty-seven days, page two, the eleventh of November, the seven clauses, the four things in the field, 297/211/213, the register at nineteen and the closing argument about being counted are all unchanged and all still in the chapter.**

**0194 — TWO REPAIRS, AND ONE OF THEM IS A CUT.** (1) The number of walls was forty, then more than forty, then about forty; **it is now one figure — out on the Friday morning into four places, forty walls by that night, more since — and the Volume 05 prompt's hundred walls is withdrawn.** (2) **The last thirteen lines of the chapter were a state dump and were cut: the register's blank line at three hundred and one days and the bulb, the card at 215 days, the letter at 217 days, the paraphrase of the four open questions, the nine who said yes in a doorway, the printed sheet and the empty column, and the eleven standing refusals are no longer restated inside the chapter. EVERY ONE OF THOSE FACTS IS UNCHANGED AND ALL OF THEM ARE IN §10, §11, §12 AND §13 OF THE CLOSE BLOCK IN `state/continuity.md`, AND NONE OF THEM IS LOST.** What was kept in the prose: the permitted Saint Orra gate sentence, used once and unstaged; the order not renewed and not ended; the clause holding and not settled; the discussion, the empty square, the two correct and useless answers, the shutter, the woman of about sixty-three, and the closing pairing of a square with nothing in it and a line under a date with nothing in it, and the volume's own sentence — a person who is not counted is not a person who is helped — which was cut with the tail and put back at the end of the chapter. The words went from 2,847 to 2,306 and the shouting from eighteen all-caps paragraphs and seven scene-breaks to one and none. **Full record: `reviews/volume-04/volume-close.md` and §20 of the close block in `state/continuity.md`.**

## Volume 05, Batch 0001 — Chapters 195–204

**Chapter 0195 — Peverell Street.
